title: Order summary
paymentModalVersionHint: Demo tenants can switch between payment modal variants for comparison testing.

quote.orderChargeTaxed: Tax includes {amount} on order-wide preferences (taxed like the service).

errors.default: The cart amounts could not be calculated. Retry, or continue to payment to see the final amounts.
errors.PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: An item is no longer in the catalog. Remove it to see the amounts.
errors.PREFERENCE_NOT_AVAILABLE: A selected preference is no longer available for this branch. Remove it to see the amounts.
errors.SERVICE_SPEED_INVALID: The selected service speed is not available. Choose another speed.
errors.TIMEZONE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The branch time zone is not set up, so prices cannot be dated. Ask an administrator to set it.
errors.PRICE_NOT_RESOLVED: An item has no price set up. Ask an administrator to price it, or set a price for this line.
errors.PRICE_BELOW_MINIMUM: A line price is below the item's minimum price.
errors.PRICE_OVERRIDE_NOT_PERMITTED: A line has a changed price, which needs the price override permission.
errors.MISSING_TENANT_CURRENCY: The Organization Base Currency is not configured.
errors.LINE_DISCOUNT_NOT_PERMITTED: A line has a discount, which needs the order discount permission.
errors.LINE_DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_GROSS: A line discount is more than the line price. Lower it to see the amounts.
errors.INVALID_ADJUSTMENT: A discount value is not valid. Check the line discounts.
